def: to show respect to someone you are grateful to

def: the time in a Veteran's Day ceremony when everyone is quiet for one minute as they pay their respects
viDef: khoảnh khắc trong lễ Cựu chiến binh khi mọi người im lặng một phút để tỏ lòng kính

def: to pay respect to or to honor by an outward act

def: the name of a famous salute, a trumpet solo played at most Remembrance Day ceremonies in Commonwealth countries
